purpose: Merge-ready contract fragment for the topology reads. DB-07 served these from the studio fixture's topology route namespace (app/topology/fixtures/topology-demo.mjs) because the contract and its generated typed client are shared files this parallel ticket does not edit. Integrator merge: append the operations and types below to contract/terrabase-api.contract.json (and update tests/contract.test.mjs's pinned operation vocabulary), run `vp run generate:client`, then replace app/topology/lib/topology-client.ts reads with the generated client methods. The fixture payloads and the validators in app/topology/lib/topology-client.ts already match these shapes exactly.

operations.name: topology.read
operations.doc: Topology snapshot: Regions, Members with Failure Domains and member health, and Bucket Range ownership with ownership epochs (engine TopologyView projected for display).

operations.name: topology.recent-writes
operations.doc: Recent replicated writes, newest first, bounded, each carrying its AcknowledgementReport facts verbatim (requested, observed, contributed Regions and Members, observation lane tick, degenerate normalization).

operations.name: topology.convergence
operations.doc: The latest Convergence observation with its condition, the per-Member replication lag as a storage-sequence distance, and the engine measurement definitions.

AcknowledgementLevel.doc: The strongest state a Region or Member has confirmed for a replicated record (engine AcknowledgementLevel; ADR-0004 D-2). Part of the public contract and distinct from local receipt.

MemberStatus.doc: Member health observation (engine ReplicationStatus). Health only: never carries or implies a Convergence fact.

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc: The ownership epoch; raised by every ownership transition of the range.

fields.name: lane
fields.doc: The lane the report comes from (synthetic until the replication data plane lands).

fields.name: laneTick
fields.doc: Lane clock tick of the snapshot.

fields.name: limits
fields.doc: Lane and qualification limits rendered with the panel.

AcknowledgementReport.doc: The observed acknowledgement for one replicated operation, engine fields verbatim.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.doc: Lane clock tick of the observation.

fields.name: normalization
fields.doc: The degenerate normalization (requested, canonical) when the topology does not distinguish the levels; null otherwise.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Each holding is the Member's own local publication fact (Local).

Convergence.doc: The contract-defined converged-state observation for one operation identity, engine fields verbatim.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.doc: Lane clock tick of the observation.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: The storage-sequence distance; never a latency claim.

fields.name: convergence
fields.doc: Absent (null) when no Convergence observation exists yet.

fields.name: definitions
fields.doc: { convergence, lag }: the engine measurement definitions, verbatim.
